verdict.rationale: HelixDB is open-source and can be run locally/embedded for free without a Cloud login (helixdb-docs-12, helixdb-docs-2, helixdb-docs-17), letting a developer prototype at zero cost via self-hosting. However, there is no documented 'free tier' for the managed Helix Cloud service, and a community report states Cloud pricing starts around $600/mo, describing it as 'above my experimentation budget' (helixdb-comm-8) — a concrete gap for anyone wanting a hosted free tier rather than self-managed infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit free-tier pricing plan for Helix Cloud, and independent confirmation that local/embedded self-hosting is a practical substitute for prototyping at scale.
